nora: heads-up  we need a tight benchmark narrative for launch that non-ML buyers can scan. proposal: 1) single heatmap (seq buckets x model family) with cost overlay, 2) a 1-slide decision flow, 3) 2 social blurbs. ok?

diego: ok. heatmap should use seq buckets 0-64 / 65-256 / 257-1024 and show median latency + $/M tokens tooltip. i'll pull run 3555551200.

ayana: messaging: keep headline neutral. draft: "Match model choice to your latency SLO and unit economics." social short: "Faster responses, smarter spend  see the tradeoffs."

bench-bot: run 3555551200 completed, artifacts -> <https://bench.internal/runs/3555551200/artifacts> :robot_face:

diego: i'll export CSV + a vega-lite mock by Thu EOD. sample CSV header in the artifact. adding cache_on/cache_off columns so we can call out caching benefits.

nora: timeline: assets + copy by next Tue. ayana  can you draft OG + two social variants by Mon? diego  heatmap PNG + CSV by Thu. i'll assemble and route to legal.

ayana: on it. small note  include a short "how we tested" box to keep claims defensible.

nora: agreed. short methodology box required. thanks all.
